old_caption:
The video captures a close-up scene of a slice of raspberry pie being garnished with fresh raspberries. The pie is placed on a white plate, and the camera focuses on the slice, highlighting its creamy texture and the vibrant red color of the raspberries. In the background, there is a white bowl filled with more raspberries, adding to the visual appeal of the scene. A glass bowl containing what appears to be powdered sugar or a similar ingredient is also visible, suggesting that the pie might have been dusted for added flavor or decoration.

As the video progresses, the camera remains steady, maintaining a consistent focus on the pie and the bowl of raspberries. A single raspberry falls at a time onto the pie, creating a sequence of individual impacts. The garnishing is in progress, with raspberries being added to the top of the pie.

caption:
The video captures a bright, shallow-depth kitchen tabletop still life centered on a wedge of pink raspberry meringue tart resting on a small white plate. A clear glass bowl of flour sits blurred in the left foreground, while a white bowl of raspberries fills the background and a few loose berries lie on the table at the right. The tart carries a small pile of red raspberries, and its arrangement stays fixed throughout the excerpt. From the top edge of the frame, raspberries enter and fall downward in a near-vertical stream toward the dessert.

As the excerpt continues, more berries appear at the top and descend steadily past the background bowl, moving just above the tart before joining the existing cluster. The falling stream remains one-after-another rather than a single mass, and also the loose berries, flour bowl, and background bowl do not shift position. The visible portion ends with several raspberries still in motion above the plate, so the topping is not shown settling into a final, completed, stable state.
